title: AISU 50ml Shortfill – Dragon Fruit
description:
On the inhale, a sweet dragon fruit flavor with a slightly sour aftertaste is followed by chilly notes of menthol providing a cooling sensation with every inhale and exhale.
AISU Dragon Fruit has 70%VG / 30%PG for maximum flavour enhancement and dense clouds and comes in a 60ml bottle with space for a nicotine shot.
70% / 30% | VG / PG
